name: dsh-agents-in-the-loop
description: DSH plugin: cross-session call center for agents. session_message delivers messages between DSH sessions (idle: visible full-text wake; busy: mid-turn-safe notice; each message delivered exactly once, compactable) and resolves targets by registered contact name (stale-id-proof). contacts is a named directory over session ids. v1.7.0 adds an optional Mission Control integration (mc.enabled, default false): MC tasks auto-spawn dsh agent sessions, comments/review-rejects are delivered, sessions close on done/failed, seats/priority/after + silent reminders + reconcile. v1.8.0 adds spawn_session (spawn.enabled, default false): in-process spawning of new persistent dsh sessions with preset+model pins via the host registry — no external scripts.
